participation.context: Spoke to keep the fish in play, and would not divide the bill.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Brought the grievance, stole the salt-fish, and admired a bill he had not got.
participation.name: Thomas Nashe

participation.context: Replaced the tallow with a fish, and contested the theft.
participation.name: Will Kemp

participation.context: Set down two shillings and eightpence, and the jug, and ended the louder half.
participation.name: Alice Brambleby

relations.note: she ends his argument with the paper
relations.quote: Master Nashe, wit is not money. I have tried paying the brewer in it.

story.body: Kemp turned a bladder of tallow into a salt-fish, and Nashe stole the fish. You spoke enough to keep it in the room. Alice set down two shillings and eightpence, and the jug. You did not divide the bill.

relations.note: she ends his argument with the paper
relations.quote: Master Nashe, wit is not money. I have tried paying the brewer in it.

title: Kept the supper going at the Split Hazel
